title: Arithmetic of Jacobi polynomials
summary: We study the arithmetic of Jacobi polynomials. As applications, we prove the Mahlburg--Ono conjecture on the irreducibility and Galois groups of the four Kaneko--Zagier families, and the Cullinan--Hajir conjecture on the Galois groups of Legendre polynomials. Other applications concern common zeros of Jacobi polynomials, harmonic functions on cones, and hyperelliptic Jacobians.
